name: onero H1
summary:
onero H1 is SwitchBot’s household humanoid robot, intended to handle a range of home chores. Its Omni Sense VLA system combines visual, depth, touch and language inputs; the manufacturer describes laundry and dishwashing as target tasks.

SwitchBot positions H1 to work alongside a floor-cleaning robot, extending cleaning and handling to objects and surfaces above floor level. The official store currently marks the model as coming soon. Household task coverage and continuous learning are manufacturer claims, and the page does not establish independently tested reliability or a confirmed shippin
